en: (115) And whoever opposes the Messenger after guidance has become clear to him and follows other than the way of the believers - We will give him what he has taken[218] and drive him into Hell, and evil it is as a destination.
enNotes: [218]- i.e., make him responsible for his choice.
tr: Wamay yushāqiqir-rasūla mim baʿdi mā tabayyana lahul-hudā wayattabiʿ ghayra sabīlil-muʾminīna nuwallihī mā tawallā wanuṣlihī jahannam, wasāʾat maṣīrā

ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ أَن يُشْرَكَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَمَن يُشْرِكْ بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلًۢا بَعِيدًا
en: (116) Indeed, Allāh does not forgive association with Him, but He forgives what is less than that for whom He wills. And he who associates others with Allāh has certainly gone far astray.
tr: Innallāha lā yaghfiru ay yushraka bihī wayaghfiru mā dūna dhālika limay yashāʾ, wamay yushrik billāhi faqad ḍalla ḍalālam baʿīdā

ar: إِن يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ إِنَٰثًا وَإِن يَدْعُونَ إِلَّا شَيْطَٰنًا مَّرِيدًا
en: (117) They call upon instead of Him none but female [deities], and they [actually] call upon none but a rebellious Satan,
tr: Iy yadʿūna min dūnihī illā ināthā, waʾiy yadʿūna illā shayṭānam marīdā

ar: لَّعَنَهُ ٱللَّهُ وَقَالَ لَأَتَّخِذَنَّ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيبًا مَّفْرُوضًا
en: (118) Whom Allāh has cursed. For he had said, "I will surely take from among Your servants a specific portion.
tr: Laʿanahullāh, waqāla laʾattakhidhanna min ʿibādika naṣībam mafrūḍā

ar: وَلَأُضِلَّنَّهُمْ وَلَأُمَنِّيَنَّهُمْ وَلَـَٔامُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ ءَاذَانَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ وَلَـَٔامُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُغَيِّرُنَّ خَلْقَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَن يَتَّخِذِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ وَلِيًّا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ خَسِرَ خُسْرَانًا مُّبِينًا
en: (119) And I will mislead them, and I will arouse in them [sinful] desires, and I will command them so they will slit the ears of cattle, and I will command them so they will change the creation of Allāh." And whoever takes Satan as an ally instead of Allāh has certainly sustained a clear loss.
tr: Walaʾuḍillannahum walaʾumanniyannahum walaʾāmurannahum falayubattikunna ādhānal-anʿāmi walaʾāmurannahum falayughayyirunna khalqallāh, wamay yattakhidhish-shayṭāna waliyyam min dūnillāhi faqad khasira khusrānam mubīnā

ar: يَعِدُهُمْ وَيُمَنِّيهِمْ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
en: (120) He [i.e., Satan] promises them and arouses desire in them. But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
tr: Yaʿiduhum wayumannīhim, wamā yaʿiduhumush-shayṭānu illā ghurūrā

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ عَنْهَا مَحِيصًا
en: (121) The refuge of those will be Hell, and they will not find from it an escape.
tr: Ulāʾika maʾwāhum jahannam, walā yajidūna ʿanhā maḥīṣā

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَنُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقًّا وَمَنْ أَصْدَقُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ قِيلًا
en: (122) But the ones who believe and do righteous deeds - We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. [It is] the promise of Allāh, [which is] truth, and who is more truthful than Allāh in statement.
tr: Wal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti sanudkhiluhum jannātin tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadā, waʿdallāhi ḥaqqā, waman aṣdaqu minallāhi qīlā

ar: لَّيْسَ بِأَمَانِيِّكُمْ وَلَآ أَمَانِىِّ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَن يَعْمَلْ سُوٓءًا يُجْزَ بِهِۦ وَلَا يَجِدْ لَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
en: (123) It [i.e., Paradise] is not [obtained] by your wishful thinking nor by that of the People of the Scripture. Whoever does a wrong will be recompensed for it, and he will not find besides Allāh a protector or a helper.
tr: Laysa biʾamāniyyikum walā amāniyyi ahlil-kitāb, may yaʿmal sūʾay yujza bihī walā yajid lahū min dūnillāhi waliyyaw walā naṣīrā

ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ نَقِيرًا
en: (124) And whoever does righteous deeds, whether male or female, while being a believer - those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged, [even as much as] the speck on a date seed.
tr: Wamay yaʿmal minaṣ-ṣāliḥāti min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa muʾminun faʾulāʾika yadkhulūnal-jannata walā yuẓlamūna naqīrā

ar: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ دِينًا مِّمَّنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ وَٱتَّبَعَ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ خَلِيلًا
en: (125) And who is better in religion than one who submits himself to Allāh while being a doer of good and follows the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth? And Allāh took Abraham as an intimate friend.
tr: Waman aḥsanu dīnam mimman aslama wajhahū lillāhi wahuwa muḥsinuw wattabaʿa millata ibrāhīma ḥanīfā, wattakhadhallāhu ibrāhīma khalīlā

ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ مُّحِيطًا
en: (126) And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And ever is Allāh, of all things, encompassing.
tr: Walillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, wakānallāhu bikulli shayʾim muḥīṭā

ar: وَيَسْتَفْتُونَكَ فِى ٱلنِّسَآءِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِيهِنَّ وَمَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ فِى يَتَٰمَى ٱلنِّسَآءِ ٱلَّٰتِى لَا تُؤْتُونَهُنَّ مَا كُتِبَ لَهُنَّ وَتَرْغَبُونَ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ وَٱلْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنِ وَأَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلْيَتَٰمَىٰ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَمَا تَفْعَلُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمًا
en: (127) And they request from you, [O Muḥammad], a [legal] ruling concerning women. Say, "Allāh gives you a ruling about them and [about] what has been recited to you in the Book concerning the orphan girls to whom you do not give what is decreed for them[219] - and [yet] you desire to marry them - and concerning the oppressed among children and that you maintain for orphans [their rights] in justice." And whatever you do of good - indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing of it.
enNotes: [219]- i.e., their rights, in general, and their mahr, specifically.
tr: Wayastaftūnaka fin-nisāʾ, qulillāhu yuftīkum fīhinna wamā yutlā ʿalaykum fil-kitābi fī yatāman-nisāʾillātī lā tuʾtūnahunna mā kutiba lahunna watarghabūna an tankiḥūhunna wal-mustaḍʿafīna minal-wildāni waʾan taqūmū lil-yatāmā bil-qisṭ, wamā tafʿalū min khayrin faʾinnallāha kāna bihī ʿalīmā

ar: وَإِنِ ٱمْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنۢ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَآ أَن يُصْلِحَا بَيْنَهُمَا صُلْحًا وَٱلصُّلْحُ خَيْرٌ وَأُحْضِرَتِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ ٱلشُّحَّ وَإِن تُحْسِنُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
en: (128) And if a woman fears from her husband contempt or evasion, there is no sin upon them if they make terms of settlement between them - and settlement is best. And present in [human] souls is stinginess.[220] But if you do good and fear Allāh - then indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.
enNotes: [220]- i.e., holding on to self-interests.
tr: Waʾinimraʾatun khāfat mim baʿlihā nushūzan aw iʿrāḍan falā junāḥa ʿalayhimā ay yuṣliḥā baynahumā ṣulḥā, waṣ-ṣulḥu khayr, waʾuḥḍiratil-anfusush-shuḥḥ, waʾin tuḥsinū watattaqū faʾinnallāha kāna bimā taʿmalūna khabīrā

ar: وَلَن تَسْتَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَن تَعْدِلُوا۟ بَيْنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَلَوْ حَرَصْتُمْ فَلَا تَمِيلُوا۟ كُلَّ ٱلْمَيْلِ فَتَذَرُوهَا كَٱلْمُعَلَّقَةِ وَإِن تُصْلِحُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
en: (129) And you will never be able to be equal [in feeling] between wives, even if you should strive [to do so]. So do not incline completely [toward one] and leave another hanging.[221] And if you amend [your affairs] and fear Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.
enNotes: [221]- Neither divorced nor enjoying the rights of marriage.
tr: Walan tastaṭīʿū an taʿdilū baynan-nisāʾi walaw ḥaraṣtum falā tamīlū kullal-mayli fatadharūhā kal-muʿallaqah, waʾin tuṣliḥū watattaqū faʾinnallāha kāna ghafūrar raḥīmā

ar: وَإِن يَتَفَرَّقَا يُغْنِ ٱللَّهُ كُلًّا مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعًا حَكِيمًا
en: (130) But if they separate [by divorce], Allāh will enrich each [of them] from His abundance. And ever is Allāh Encompassing and Wise.
tr: Waʾiy yatafarraqā yughnillāhu kullam min saʿatih, wakānallāhu wāsiʿan ḥakīmā

ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَقَدْ وَصَّيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ أَنِ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَإِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَنِيًّا حَمِيدًا
en: (131) And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And We have instructed those who were given the Scripture before you and yourselves to fear Allāh. But if you disbelieve - then to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And ever is Allāh Free of need and Praiseworthy.
tr: Walillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, walaqad waṣṣaynal-ladhīna ūtul-kitāba min qablikum waʾiyyākum anittaqullāh, waʾin takfurū faʾinna lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, wakānallāhu ghaniyyan ḥamīdā

ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
en: (132) And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.[222]
enNotes: [222]- Refer to footnote in 3:173.
tr: Walillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, wakafā billāhi wakīlā

ar: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَيَأْتِ بِـَٔاخَرِينَ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ قَدِيرًا
en: (133) If He wills, He can do away with you, O people, and bring others [in your place]. And ever is Allāh competent to do that.
tr: Iy yashaʾ yudhhibkum ayyuhan-nāsu wayaʾti biʾākharīn, wakānallāhu ʿalā dhālika qadīrā

ar: مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنْيَا فَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ ثَوَابُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
en: (134) Whoever desires the reward of this world - then with Allāh is the reward of this world and the Hereafter. And ever is Allāh Hearing and Seeing.
tr: Man kāna yurīdu thawābad-dunyā faʿindallāhi thawābud-dunyā wal-ākhirah, wakānallāhu samīʿam baṣīrā

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ قَوَّٰمِينَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ شُهَدَآءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوِ ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ وَٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ إِن يَكُنْ غَنِيًّا أَوْ فَقِيرًا فَٱللَّهُ أَوْلَىٰ بِهِمَا فَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ أَن تَعْدِلُوا۟ وَإِن تَلْوُۥٓا۟ أَوْ تُعْرِضُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا
en: (135) O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm in justice, witnesses for Allāh, even if it be against yourselves or parents and relatives. Whether one is rich or poor, Allāh is more worthy of both.[223] So follow not [personal] inclination, lest you not be just. And if you distort [your testimony] or refuse [to give it], then indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.
enNotes: [223]- i.e., more knowledgeable of their best interests. Therefore, adhere to what He has enjoined upon you and testify honestly.
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū kūnū qawwāmīna bil-qisṭi shuhadāʾa lillāhi walaw ʿalā anfusikum awil-wālidayni wal-aqrabīn, iy yakun ghaniyyan aw faqīran fallāhu awlā bihimā, falā tattabiʿul-hawā an taʿdilū, waʾin talwū aw tuʿriḍū faʾinnallāha kāna bimā taʿmalūna khabīrā

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِن قَبْلُ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَٰلًۢا بَعِيدًا
en: (136) O you who have believed, believe[224] in Allāh and His Messenger and the Book that He sent down upon His Messenger and the Scripture which He sent down before. And whoever disbelieves in Allāh, His angels, His books, His messengers, and the Last Day has certainly gone far astray.
enNotes: [224]- i.e., renew, confirm and adhere to your belief.
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū āminū billāhi warasūlihī wal-kitābil-ladhī nazzala ʿalā rasūlihī wal-kitābil-ladhī anzala min qabl, wamay yakfur billāhi wamalāʾikatihī wakutubihī warusulihī wal-yawmil-ākhiri faqad ḍalla ḍalālam baʿīdā

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ ثُمَّ ءَامَنُوا۟ ثُمَّ كَفَرُوا۟ ثُمَّ ٱزْدَادُوا۟ كُفْرًا لَّمْ يَكُنِ ٱللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ وَلَا لِيَهْدِيَهُمْ سَبِيلًۢا
en: (137) Indeed, those who have believed then disbelieved, then believed then disbelieved, and then increased in disbelief - never will Allāh forgive them, nor will He guide them to a way.
tr: Innal-ladhīna āmanū thumma kafarū thumma āmanū thumma kafarū thummazdādū kufral lam yakunillāhu liyaghfira lahum walā liyahdiyahum sabīlā

ar: بَشِّرِ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
en: (138) Give tidings to the hypocrites that there is for them a painful punishment -
tr: Bashshiril-munāfiqīna biʾanna lahum ʿadhāban alīmā

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّخِذُونَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَيَبْتَغُونَ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَإِنَّ ٱلْعِزَّةَ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًا
en: (139) Those who take disbelievers as allies instead of the believers. Do they seek with them honor [through power]? But indeed, honor belongs to Allāh entirely.[225]
enNotes: [225]- Being the source of all power and honor, Allāh grants them to whom He wills.
tr: Al-ladhīna yattakhidhūnal-kāfirīna awliyāʾa min dūnil-muʾminīn, ayabtaghūna ʿindahumul-ʿizzata faʾinnal-ʿizzata lillāhi jamīʿā

ar: وَقَدْ نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَنْ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يُكْفَرُ بِهَا وَيُسْتَهْزَأُ بِهَا فَلَا تَقْعُدُوا۟ مَعَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَخُوضُوا۟ فِى حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا مِّثْلُهُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ جَامِعُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ جَمِيعًا
en: (140) And it has already come down to you in the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] that when you hear the verses of Allāh [recited], they are denied [by them] and ridiculed; so do not sit with them until they enter into another conversation. Indeed, you would then be like them.[226] Indeed, Allāh will gather the hypocrites and disbelievers in Hell all together -
enNotes: [226]- In this world, by participation in their blasphemy, and in the next, where you will share their punishment.
tr: Waqad nazzala ʿalaykum fil-kitābi an idhā samiʿtum āyātillāhi yukfaru bihā wayustahzaʾu bihā falā taqʿudū maʿahum ḥattā yakhūḍū fī ḥadīthin ghayrih, innakum idham mithluhum, innallāha jāmiʿul-munāfiqīna wal-kāfirīna fī jahannama jamīʿā

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَرَبَّصُونَ بِكُمْ فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ فَتْحٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ قَالُوٓا۟ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ وَإِن كَانَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ نَصِيبٌ قَالُوٓا۟ أَلَمْ نَسْتَحْوِذْ عَلَيْكُمْ وَنَمْنَعْكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَلَن يَجْعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ سَبِيلًا
en: (141) Those who wait [and watch] you. Then if you gain a victory from Allāh, they say, "Were we not with you?" But if the disbelievers have a success, they say [to them], "Did we not gain the advantage over you, but we protected you from the believers?" Allāh will judge between [all of] you on the Day of Resurrection, and never will Allāh give the disbelievers over the believers a way [to overcome them].[227]
enNotes: [227]- In the Hereafter, but possibly in this world as well.
tr: Al-ladhīna yatarabbaṣūna bikum, faʾin kāna lakum fatḥum minallāhi qālū alam nakum maʿakum, waʾin kāna lil-kāfirīna naṣībun qālū alam nastaḥwidh ʿalaykum wanamnaʿkum minal-muʾminīn, fallāhu yaḥkumu baynakum yawmal-qiyāmah, walay yajʿalallāhu lil-kāfirīna ʿalal-muʾminīna sabīlā

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ يُخَٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَهُوَ خَٰدِعُهُمْ وَإِذَا قَامُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ قَامُوا۟ كُسَالَىٰ يُرَآءُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَلَا يَذْكُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
en: (142) Indeed, the hypocrites [think to] deceive Allāh, but He is deceiving them. And when they stand for prayer, they stand lazily, showing [themselves to] the people and not remembering Allāh except a little,
tr: Innal-munāfiqīna yukhādiʿūnallāha wahuwa khādiʿuhum, waʾidhā qāmū ilaṣ-ṣalāti qāmū kusālā yurāʾūnan-nāsa walā yadhkurūnallāha illā qalīlā

ar: مُّذَبْذَبِينَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ لَآ إِلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَلَآ إِلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ سَبِيلًا
en: (143) Wavering between them, [belonging] neither to these [i.e., the believers] nor to those [i.e., the disbelievers]. And whoever Allāh sends astray - never will you find for him a way.
tr: Mudhabdhabīna bayna dhālik, lā ilā hāʾulāʾi walā ilā hāʾulāʾ, wamay yuḍlilillāhu falan tajida lahū sabīlā

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَتُرِيدُونَ أَن تَجْعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ سُلْطَٰنًا مُّبِينًا
en: (144) O you who have believed, do not take the disbelievers as allies instead of the believers. Do you wish to give Allāh against yourselves a clear case?
tr: Yā ayyuhal-ladhīna āmanū lā tattakhidhul-kāfirīna awliyāʾa min dūnil-muʾminīn, aturīdūna an tajʿalū lillāhi ʿalaykum sulṭānam mubīnā

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ فِى ٱلدَّرْكِ ٱلْأَسْفَلِ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ نَصِيرًا
en: (145) Indeed, the hypocrites will be in the lowest depths of the Fire - and never will you find for them a helper -
tr: Innal-munāfiqīna fid-darkil-asfali minan-nār, walan tajida lahum naṣīrā

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ وَٱعْتَصَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَأَخْلَصُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لِلَّهِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مَعَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَسَوْفَ يُؤْتِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
en: (146) Except for those who repent, correct themselves, hold fast to Allāh, and are sincere in their religion for Allāh, for those will be with the believers. And Allāh is going to give the believers a great reward.
tr: Illal-ladhīna tābū waʾaṣlaḥū waʿtaṣamū billāhi waʾakhlaṣū dīnahum lillāhi faʾulāʾika maʿal-muʾminīn, wasawfa yuʾtillāhul-muʾminīna ajran ʿaẓīmā

ar: مَّا يَفْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بِعَذَابِكُمْ إِن شَكَرْتُمْ وَءَامَنتُمْ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ شَاكِرًا عَلِيمًا
en: (147) What would Allāh do with [i.e., gain from] your punishment if you are grateful and believe? And ever is Allāh Appreciative[228] and Knowing.
enNotes: [228]- Of repentance, self-discipline and good deeds, rewarding for them abundantly.
tr: Mā yafʿalullāhu biʿadhābikum in shakartum waʾāmantum, wakānallāhu shākiran ʿalīmā

ar: لَّا يُحِبُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْجَهْرَ بِٱلسُّوٓءِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ إِلَّا مَن ظُلِمَ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ سَمِيعًا عَلِيمًا
en: (148) Allāh does not like the public mention of evil except by one who has been wronged. And ever is Allāh Hearing and Knowing.
tr: Lā yuḥibbullāhul-jahra bis-sūʾi minal-qawli illā man ẓulim, wakānallāhu samīʿan ʿalīmā

ar: إِن تُبْدُوا۟ خَيْرًا أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ أَوْ تَعْفُوا۟ عَن سُوٓءٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا قَدِيرًا
en: (149) If [instead] you show [some] good or conceal it or pardon an offense - indeed, Allāh is ever Pardoning and Competent.[229]
enNotes: [229]- Allāh is always able to exact retribution, although He pardons out of His grace.
tr: In tubdū khayran aw tukhfūhu aw taʿfū ʿan sūʾin faʾinnallāha kāna ʿafuwwan qadīrā

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَن يُفَرِّقُوا۟ بَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَيَقُولُونَ نُؤْمِنُ بِبَعْضٍ وَنَكْفُرُ بِبَعْضٍ وَيُرِيدُونَ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا
en: (150) Indeed, those who disbelieve in Allāh and His messengers and wish to discriminate between Allāh and His messengers and say, "We believe in some and disbelieve in others," and wish to adopt a way in between -
tr: Innal-ladhīna yakfurūna billāhi warusulihī wayurīdūna ay yufarriqū baynallāhi warusulihī wayaqūlūna nuʾminu bibaʿḍiw wanakfuru bibaʿḍiw wayurīdūna ay yattakhidhū bayna dhālika sabīlā

ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ حَقًّا وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابًا مُّهِينًا
en: (151) Those are the disbelievers, truly. And We have prepared for the disbelievers a humiliating punishment.
tr: Ulāʾika humul-kāfirūna ḥaqqā, waʾaʿtadnā lil-kāfirīna ʿadhābam muhīnā

ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَلَمْ يُفَرِّقُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ سَوْفَ يُؤْتِيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
en: (152) But they who believe in Allāh and His messengers and do not discriminate between any of them - to those He is going to give their rewards. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Wal-ladhīna āmanū billāhi warusulihī walam yufarriqū bayna aḥadim minhum ulāʾika sawfa yuʾtīhim ujūrahum, wakānallāhu ghafūrar raḥīmā

ar: يَسْـَٔلُكَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَن تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ كِتَٰبًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَقَدْ سَأَلُوا۟ مُوسَىٰٓ أَكْبَرَ مِن ذَٰلِكَ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَرِنَا ٱللَّهَ جَهْرَةً فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ بِظُلْمِهِمْ ثُمَّ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ ٱلْعِجْلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ فَعَفَوْنَا عَن ذَٰلِكَ وَءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ سُلْطَٰنًا مُّبِينًا
en: (153) The People of the Scripture ask you to bring down to them a book from the heaven. But they had asked of Moses [even] greater than that and said, "Show us Allāh outright," so the thunderbolt struck them for their wrongdoing. Then they took the calf [for worship] after clear evidences had come to them, and We pardoned that. And We gave Moses a clear authority.
tr: Yasʾaluka ahlul-kitābi an tunazzila ʿalayhim kitābam minas-samāʾi faqad saʾalū mūsā akbara min dhālika faqālū arinallāha jahratan faʾakhadhathumuṣ-ṣāʿiqatu biẓulmihim, thummattakhadhul-ʿijla mim baʿdi mā jāʾathumul-bayyinātu faʿafawnā ʿan dhālik, waʾātaynā mūsā sulṭānam mubīnā

ar: وَرَفَعْنَا فَوْقَهُمُ ٱلطُّورَ بِمِيثَٰقِهِمْ وَقُلْنَا لَهُمُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ لَا تَعْدُوا۟ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ وَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُم مِّيثَٰقًا غَلِيظًا
en: (154) And We raised over them the mount for [refusal of] their covenant; and We said to them, "Enter the gate bowing humbly"; and We said to them, "Do not transgress on the sabbath"; and We took from them a solemn covenant.
tr: Warafaʿnā fawqahumuṭ-ṭūra bimīthāqihim waqulnā lahumudkhulul-bāba sujjadaw waqulnā lahum lā taʿdū fis-sabti waʾakhadhnā minhum mīthāqan ghalīẓā

ar: فَبِمَا نَقْضِهِم مِّيثَٰقَهُمْ وَكُفْرِهِم بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَقَتْلِهِمُ ٱلْأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَقَوْلِهِمْ قُلُوبُنَا غُلْفٌۢ بَلْ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
en: (155) And [We cursed them][230] for their breaking of the covenant and their disbelief in the signs of Allāh and their killing of the prophets without right and their saying, "Our hearts are wrapped" [i.e., sealed against reception]. Rather, Allāh has sealed them because of their disbelief, so they believe not, except for a few.[231]
enNotes:
[230]- Another interpretation is "And [We made certain good foods unlawful to them]," based upon verse 160.
[231]- Or "except with little belief."
tr: Fabimā naqḍihim mīthāqahum wakufrihim biʾāyātillāhi waqatlihimul-ambiyāʾa bighayri ḥaqqiw waqawlihim qulūbunā ghulf, bal ṭabaʿallāhu ʿalayhā bikufrihim falā yuʾminūna illā qalīlā

ar: وَبِكُفْرِهِمْ وَقَوْلِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَرْيَمَ بُهْتَٰنًا عَظِيمًا
en: (156) And [We cursed them] for their disbelief and their saying against Mary a great slander[232]
enNotes: [232]- When they accused her of fornication.
tr: Wabikufrihim waqawlihim ʿalā maryama buhtānan ʿaẓīmā

ar: وَقَوْلِهِمْ إِنَّا قَتَلْنَا ٱلْمَسِيحَ عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ وَمَا صَلَبُوهُ وَلَٰكِن شُبِّهَ لَهُمْ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِلَّا ٱتِّبَاعَ ٱلظَّنِّ وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ يَقِينًۢا
en: (157) And [for] their saying, "Indeed, we have killed the Messiah, Jesus the son of Mary, the messenger of Allāh." And they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him; but [another] was made to resemble him to them. And indeed, those who differ over it are in doubt about it. They have no knowledge of it except the following of assumption. And they did not kill him, for certain.[233]
enNotes: [233]- Another meaning is "And they did not kill him, being certain [of his identity]," i.e., they killed another assuming it was Jesus (upon whom be peace).
tr: Waqawlihim innā qatalnal-masīḥa ʿīsabna maryama rasūlallāh, wamā qatalūhu wamā ṣalabūhu walākin shubbiha lahum, waʾinnal-ladhīnakhtalafū fīhi lafī shakkim minh, mā lahum bihī min ʿilmin illattibāʿaẓ-ẓanni wamā qatalūhu yaqīnā

ar: بَل رَّفَعَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
en: (158) Rather, Allāh raised him to Himself. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.
tr: Bar rafaʿahullāhu ilayh, wakānallāhu ʿazīzan ḥakīmā

ar: وَإِن مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِلَّا لَيُؤْمِنَنَّ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِۦ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا
en: (159) And there is none from the People of the Scripture but that he will surely believe in him [i.e., Jesus] before his death.[234] And on the Day of Resurrection he will be against them a witness.
enNotes: [234]- One interpretation is that "his death" refers to that of Jesus after his return to earth. Or it can mean "the death of every individual from among the People of the Scripture."
tr: Waʾim min ahlil-kitābi illā layuʾminanna bihī qabla mawtih, wayawmal-qiyāmati yakūnu ʿalayhim shahīdā

ar: فَبِظُلْمٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَادُوا۟ حَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ طَيِّبَٰتٍ أُحِلَّتْ لَهُمْ وَبِصَدِّهِمْ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ كَثِيرًا
en: (160) For wrongdoing on the part of the Jews, We made unlawful for them [certain] good foods which had been lawful to them, and for their averting from the way of Allāh many [people],
tr: Fabiẓulmim minal-ladhīna hādū ḥarramnā ʿalayhim ṭayyibātin uḥillat lahum wabiṣaddihim ʿan sabīlillāhi kathīrā

ar: وَأَخْذِهِمُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ وَقَدْ نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَأَكْلِهِمْ أَمْوَٰلَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
en: (161) And [for] their taking of usury while they had been forbidden from it, and their consuming of the people's wealth unjustly. And We have prepared for the disbelievers among them a painful punishment.
tr: Waʾakhdhihimur-ribā waqad nuhū ʿanhu waʾaklihim amwālan-nāsi bil-bāṭil, waʾaʿtadnā lil-kāfirīna minhum ʿadhāban alīmā

ar: لَّٰكِنِ ٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ مِنْهُمْ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَٱلْمُقِيمِينَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱلْمُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ سَنُؤْتِيهِمْ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
en: (162) But those firm in knowledge among them and the believers believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what was revealed before you. And the establishers of prayer [especially] and the givers of zakāh and the believers in Allāh and the Last Day - those We will give a great reward.
tr: Lākinir-rāsikhūna fil-ʿilmi minhum wal-muʾminūna yuʾminūna bimā unzila ilayka wamā unzila min qablika wal-muqīmīnaṣ-ṣalāta wal-muʾtūnaz-zakāta wal-muʾminūna billāhi wal-yawmil-ākhir, ulāʾika sanuʾtīhim ajran ʿaẓīmā

ar: إِنَّآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ كَمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ نُوحٍ وَٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَعِيسَىٰ وَأَيُّوبَ وَيُونُسَ وَهَٰرُونَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورًا
en: (163) Indeed, We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him. And We revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, the Descendants,[235] Jesus, Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon; and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].
enNotes: [235]- Al-Asbāṭ. See footnote to 2:136.
tr: Innā awḥaynā ilayka kamā awḥaynā ilā nūḥiw wan-nabiyyīna mim baʿdih, waʾawḥaynā ilā ibrāhīma waʾismāʿīla waʾisḥāqa wayaʿqūba wal-asbāṭi waʿīsā waʾayyūba wayūnusa wahārūna wasulaymān, waʾātaynā dāwūda zabūrā

ar: وَرُسُلًا قَدْ قَصَصْنَٰهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَرُسُلًا لَّمْ نَقْصُصْهُمْ عَلَيْكَ وَكَلَّمَ ٱللَّهُ مُوسَىٰ تَكْلِيمًا
en: (164) And [We sent] messengers about whom We have related [their stories] to you before and messengers about whom We have not related to you. And Allāh spoke to Moses with [direct] speech.
tr: Warusulan qad qaṣaṣnāhum ʿalayka min qablu warusulal lam naqṣuṣhum ʿalayk, wakallamallāhu mūsā taklīmā

ar: رُّسُلًا مُّبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ لِئَلَّا يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ حُجَّةٌۢ بَعْدَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
en: (165) [We sent] messengers as bringers of good tidings and warners so that mankind will have no argument against Allāh after the messengers. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.
tr: Rusulam mubashshirīna wamundhirīna liʾallā yakūna lin-nāsi ʿalallāhi ḥujjatum baʿdar-rusul, wakānallāhu ʿazīzan ḥakīmā

ar: لَّٰكِنِ ٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكَ أَنزَلَهُۥ بِعِلْمِهِۦ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يَشْهَدُونَ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًا
en: (166) But Allāh bears witness to that which He has revealed to you. He has sent it down with His knowledge, and the angels bear witness [as well]. And sufficient is Allāh as Witness.
tr: Lākinillāhu yashhadu bimā anzala ilayka anzalahū biʿilmih, wal-malāʾikatu yashhadūn, wakafā billāhi shahīdā

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ قَدْ ضَلُّوا۟ ضَلَٰلًۢا بَعِيدًا
en: (167) Indeed, those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh have certainly gone far astray.
tr: Innal-ladhīna kafarū waṣaddū ʿan sabīlillāhi qad ḍallū ḍalālam baʿīdā

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَظَلَمُوا۟ لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱللَّهُ لِيَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ وَلَا لِيَهْدِيَهُمْ طَرِيقًا
en: (168) Indeed, those who disbelieve and commit wrong [or injustice] - never will Allāh forgive them, nor will He guide them to a path,
tr: Innal-ladhīna kafarū waẓalamū lam yakunillāhu liyaghfira lahum walā liyahdiyahum ṭarīqā

ar: إِلَّا طَرِيقَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
en: (169) Except the path of Hell; they will abide therein forever. And that, for Allāh, is [always] easy.
tr: Illā ṭarīqa jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadā, wakāna dhālika ʿalallāhi yasīrā

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَكُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِٱلْحَقِّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ خَيْرًا لَّكُمْ وَإِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
en: (170) O mankind, the Messenger has come to you with the truth from your Lord, so believe; it is better for you. But if you disbelieve - then indeed, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. And ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise.
tr: Yā ayyuhan-nāsu qad jāʾakumur-rasūlu bil-ḥaqqi mir rabbikum faʾāminū khayral lakum, waʾin takfurū faʾinna lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wakānallāhu ʿalīman ḥakīmā

ar: يَٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا تَغْلُوا۟ فِى دِينِكُمْ وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلْحَقَّ إِنَّمَا ٱلْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُۥٓ أَلْقَىٰهَآ إِلَىٰ مَرْيَمَ وَرُوحٌ مِّنْهُ فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ وَلَا تَقُولُوا۟ ثَلَٰثَةٌ ٱنتَهُوا۟ خَيْرًا لَّكُمْ إِنَّمَا ٱللَّهُ إِلَٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ أَن يَكُونَ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًا
en: (171) O People of the Scripture, do not commit excess in your religion[236] or say about Allāh except the truth. The Messiah, Jesus the son of Mary, was but a messenger of Allāh and His word which He directed to Mary and a soul [created at a command] from Him. So believe in Allāh and His messengers. And do not say, "Three"; desist - it is better for you. Indeed, Allāh is but one God. Exalted is He above having a son. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
enNotes: [236]- Such as attributing divine qualities to certain creations of Allāh or revering them excessively.
tr: Yā ahlal-kitābi lā taghlū fī dīnikum walā taqūlū ʿalallāhi illal-ḥaqq, innamal-masīḥu ʿīsabnu maryama rasūlullāhi wakalimatuh, al-qāhā ilā maryama warūḥum minh, faʾāminū billāhi warusulih, walā taqūlū thalāthah, intahū khayral lakum, innamallāhu ilāhuw wāḥid, subḥānahū ay yakūna lahū walad, lahū mā fis-samāwāti wamā fil-arḍ, wakafā billāhi wakīlā

ar: لَّن يَسْتَنكِفَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ أَن يَكُونَ عَبْدًا لِّلَّهِ وَلَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ وَمَن يَسْتَنكِفْ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَيَسْتَكْبِرْ فَسَيَحْشُرُهُمْ إِلَيْهِ جَمِيعًا
en: (172) Never would the Messiah disdain to be a servant of Allāh, nor would the angels near [to Him]. And whoever disdains His worship and is arrogant - He will gather them to Himself all together.
tr: Lay yastankifal-masīḥu ay yakūna ʿabdal lillāhi walal-malāʾikatul-muqarrabūn, wamay yastankif ʿan ʿibādatihī wayastakbir fasayaḥshuruhum ilayhi jamīʿā

ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَنكَفُوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فَيُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا
en: (173) And as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, He will give them in full their rewards and grant them extra from His bounty. But as for those who disdained and were arrogant, He will punish them with a painful punishment, and they will not find for themselves besides Allāh any protector or helper.
tr: Faʾammal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fayuwaffīhim ujūrahum wayazīduhum min faḍlih, waʾammal-ladhīnastankafū wastakbarū fayuʿadhdhibuhum ʿadhāban alīmaw walā yajidūna lahum min dūnillāhi waliyyaw walā naṣīrā

ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدْ جَآءَكُم بُرْهَٰنٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ نُورًا مُّبِينًا
en: (174) O mankind, there has come to you a conclusive proof from your Lord, and We have sent down to you a clear light.[237]
enNotes: [237]- Showing the truth (i.e., the Qur’ān).
tr: Yā ayyuhan-nāsu qad jāʾakum burhānum mir rabbikum waʾanzalnā ilaykum nūram mubīnā

ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱعْتَصَمُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيُدْخِلُهُمْ فِى رَحْمَةٍ مِّنْهُ وَفَضْلٍ وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلَيْهِ صِرَٰطًا مُّسْتَقِيمًا
en: (175) So those who believe in Allāh and hold fast to Him - He will admit them to mercy from Himself and bounty and guide them to Himself on a straight path.
tr: Faʾammal-ladhīna āmanū billāhi waʿtaṣamū bihī fasayudkhiluhum fī raḥmatim minhu wafaḍliw wayahdīhim ilayhi ṣirāṭam mustaqīmā

ar: يَسْتَفْتُونَكَ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُفْتِيكُمْ فِى ٱلْكَلَٰلَةِ إِنِ ٱمْرُؤٌا۟ هَلَكَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ وَلَدٌ وَلَهُۥٓ أُخْتٌ فَلَهَا نِصْفُ مَا تَرَكَ وَهُوَ يَرِثُهَآ إِن لَّمْ يَكُن لَّهَا وَلَدٌ فَإِن كَانَتَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ فَلَهُمَا ٱلثُّلُثَانِ مِمَّا تَرَكَ وَإِن كَانُوٓا۟ إِخْوَةً رِّجَالًا وَنِسَآءً فَلِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ أَن تَضِلُّوا۟ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ
en: (176) They request from you a [legal] ruling. Say, "Allāh gives you a ruling concerning one having neither descendants nor ascendants [as heirs]." If a man dies, leaving no child but [only] a sister, she will have half of what he left. And he inherits from her if she [dies and] has no child. But if there are two sisters [or more], they will have two thirds of what he left. If there are both brothers and sisters, the male will have the share of two females.[238] Allāh makes clear to you [His law], lest you go astray. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
enNotes: [238]- This verse relates to siblings from the father's side or from both parents, whereas in Āyah 12 it concerned those from the mother's side alone.
tr: Yastaftūnak, qulillāhu yuftīkum fil-kalālah, inimruʾun halaka laysa lahū waladuw walahū ukhtun falahā niṣfu mā tarak, wahuwa yarithuhā il lam yakul lahā walad, faʾin kānatathnatayni falahumath-thuluthāni mimmā tarak, waʾin kānū ikhwatar rijālaw wanisāʾan falidh-dhakari mithlu ḥaẓẓil-unthayayn, yubayyinullāhu lakum an taḍillū, wallāhu bikulli shayʾin ʿalīm
